why.org_a:finding:06852: Critical vulnerability on the Internet-facing web server holding secrets that unlock the crown-jewel bucket.
why.org_a:finding:06851: Web server vulnerability on the Internet-facing host holding credentials for the crown-jewel data store.

reasoning: An Internet-facing host (cobalt-sol-edge-184) contains an SSH key that can unlock access to internal data systems holding secrets for the crown-jewel data store. Fixing the vulnerabilities on this asset blocks the primary external entry point leading to the compromise of crown-jewel secrets.
